title: 30-Second Tests to Know It's God
hook: Think it's God? Run it through these 5 tests in 30 seconds.
script: Jesus said, My sheep hear my voice (John 10:27). Test one: Does it align with Scripture? God never contradicts his Word (2 Tim 3:16). Test two: Does it sound like Jesus—pure, peaceable, gentle, willing to listen (James 3:17). Test three: Does it lead to peace and Spirit-fruit, not panic and pressure (Col 3:15; Gal 5:22-23). Test four: Would wise, godly counsel agree (Prov 11:14). Test five: Are doors opening without you forcing them (Rev 3:7). If it fails, pause. Try a 7-day rhythm: 5 minutes in the Word, 2 minutes of silence, write one takeaway, share with a mentor. God isn't hiding; He's guiding.

title: When God Feels Silent: Stop These 3 Mistakes
hook: If God feels silent right now, watch this.
script: Silence makes us chase signs, set panicked deadlines, and skip Scripture. Breathe. God speaks clearly, not loudly. Swap superstition for Scripture: does this align with the Word? Check character: is it humble, pure, peaceable like Jesus? Notice the fruit: do you sense steady peace, not jittery fear? Ask counsel: what would a mature believer say? Watch providence: are doors opening without manipulation? If even one light is red, wait. Waiting isn't wasted; it's protective. Start today: read a short passage, sit two minutes in quiet, write one sentence you'll obey, and tell a trusted friend. Clarity grows with obedience.

title: Overthinking God's Will? Try the Peace Filter
script: Your Shepherd isn't playing hide-and-seek. His voice carries markers. First, Scripture steadies the signal. Second, the Jesus-tone—pure, gentle, reasonable—replaces harsh inner critics. Third, let peace be the umpire in your heart, not panic's whistle. Fourth, invite wise counsel; pride isolates, wisdom multiplies. Fifth, look for providence—doors God opens stay open. If you're forcing, it's probably you. Here's a simple reset for the week: Word for five, silence for two, write one next step, share it. Repeat. Small obedience turns down the noise so you can hear the One who loves you.
